Cc: Alyssa Greene <alyssa@bluepeak.com>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: CAIQ crosswalk + evidence for pre-sales review

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. BluePeak's security team is running a pre-sales assessment for a potential enterprise pilot and they've asked for a CAIQ crosswalk mapped to our SOC 2 evidence. Attached is the CAIQ template we're using (BluePeak_CAIQ_v3.xlsx) with the controls they'll score.

High-level asks:
- Can Redwood provide a control mapping (CAIQ control -> Redwood control/artefact) and a point of contact for each control?
- A short evidence index (how to retrieve the artifact + owner) for the subset marked "priority" in the spreadsheet (approx 40 controls).
- A 60-minute mapping workshop this week to walk owners through the expectations and evidence locations.

Timeline: BluePeak hopes to close the loop by Fri 8/13. Is that feasible?

Let me know who on your side should join the workshop and any pre-read you want us to complete.

Thanks,
Samir
Samir Patel
Senior Security Engineer
BluePeak Security

3) Finalized packet by Fri 8/13 for your review.

Hi team — following up on Kimberly's note. I've started a draft crosswalk and assigned tentative owners for the priority controls. Draft attached: caiq-crosswalk-draft.csv. Summary of status and open questions below.

Status (sample):
- CM-8 / CAC-2 (Data-in-transit): Owner = Jonas Weber (network infra). Evidence = TLS cert rotation policy + packet capture redaction guidance (stored in drive).
- IAM-4 / IAM-7 (Keys & rotation): Owner = Priyom Das (platform sec). Evidence = KMS key rotation logs + HSM attestation (partial).
- LOG-2 (Audit logs): Owner = Marissa Cole. Evidence = ELK retention config + example export.

Open questions (please confirm so we can finalize before Thu):
1) Scope: Samir, can you confirm whether the "priority" subset includes controls related to third-party model hosting (we host some weights on partner infra)? If so, we'll need to include vendor attestations.
2) Evidence format: do you prefer PDF artifacts or links to shared drives? We typically provide an "index" with links + one zip per control on request.

Action items:
- Karthik: circulate owner roster and complete crosswalk (due Tue 8/10).
- Marissa: inventory evidence artifacts and mark redaction needs (due Tue 8/10).
- Kimberly: confirm workshop agenda and attendee list.

Attachment: caiq-crosswalk-draft.csv (csv)

- Priority scope: yes, include any controls that touch third-party model hosting and data egress. We'll need vendor attestations where Redwood relies on partner infra.
- Evidence format: drive links + a short PDF binder is preferred for reviewers; PDFs are easier for non-technical exec reviewers.

Thu 8/6 at 10:00am PT works for BluePeak. Please send a calendar invite with a Google Meet link and the pre-read (we'll circulate internally on our side).

Also please add the HubSpot record so our procurement team can reference the right deal (HubSpot: 1234567).

Appreciate the fast turnaround — look forward to the workshop.
